purpose: Test a finite set of residual ways to turn the locally accepted event and fundamental schemas into a new independent three-session mechanism, before any row, candidate, comparator or return value is read.

admission_gate.gate_1_present_in_accepted_schema: The primitive must be a real field in an accepted canonical source rather than an imagined disclosure timestamp, denominator or provider attribute.
admission_gate.gate_2_cross_sectionally_rankable_econom: Identity, period keys, raw calendar ordinals, file order and smoke copies are not economic alpha states.
admission_gate.gate_3_semantically_independent: The proposal cannot be an alternate scale, threshold, count, freshness, timing, normalization, residual, interaction or categorical recode of a terminal branch.
admission_gate.gate_4_point_in_time_semantics: A stored synthetic availability clock cannot be reinterpreted as an observed reporting delay; announcement and report dates remain clocks or join keys.
admission_gate.gate_5_no_post_exposure_rescue: No new denominator, source pairing, event-family choice, inversion, subset, model or filter may be selected after prior capacity or return evidence.
admission_gate.pass_rule: All five gates must pass before a formula, direction, support rule, source row, comparator value or return value may be opened.

finite_residual_catalog.name: remaining_normalized_ratio_growth_or_precision_primitive
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_fields: all accepted ratio, growth, lag and precision columns not used as identity or clocks
finite_residual_catalog.reason: The transaction, announcement, survey, analyst, ownership, financing, accounting and forecast contracts already froze these states or their exact direction/freshness transform. Choosing another transform after those results is an operator refresh, not a new primitive.

finite_residual_catalog.name: remaining_event_count_attention_or_breadth_primitive
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_fields: event counts, report counts and organization counts
finite_residual_catalog.reason: Billboard, block, dividend, pledge, major-holder and survey counts were direct frozen factors. Analyst and insider counts were contract context or attention state; promoting a context column after the primary factor failed is a post-exposure branch change.

finite_residual_catalog.name: remaining_absolute_amount_or_share_magnitude
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_fields: absolute holder changes, planned repurchase amount, pledge share count and restricted unlock actual shares
finite_residual_catalog.reason: Holder absolute change, repurchase amount and pledge share count were already frozen. Restricted unlock actual shares is an unscaled context magnitude; choosing market value, shares outstanding, float or another accounting denominator now would combine the terminal unlock branch with an exposed scale source.

finite_residual_catalog.name: raw_announcement_trade_event_or_report_date_ordinal
finite_residual_catalog.reason: These fields establish first eligibility or report-period matching. Freshness, timeliness, delay consistency, peer crowding and report-period transitions already cover legitimate date mechanisms; ranking a calendar ordinal would encode calendar drift rather than issuer information.

finite_residual_catalog.name: actual_event_to_public_disclosure_delay
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_fields: insider transaction date versus filing date and analogous event clocks
finite_residual_catalog.reason: The insider source stores a transaction date and conservative third-session synthetic availability, not the historical public filing timestamp. Institutional survey delay is present and already terminal. Reinterpreting a synthetic clock would invent source semantics.

finite_residual_catalog.name: identity_category_provider_file_order_or_smoke_copy_state
finite_residual_catalog.candidate_fields: instrument, forecast_type, schema metadata, provider/file ordering and the margin smoke copy
finite_residual_catalog.reason: Instrument identifiers are mapping keys, forecast type/turnaround is an exposed terminal family, schema metadata is not a row state, and a smoke duplicate is not an independent accepted source.

decision.reason: Every actual local field is already terminal, a clock/key/context field, an unscaled rescue, a categorical recode or a non-authoritative duplicate; the one concept needing actual filing time is not present in the source.

next_action: Record all six scientific decisions plus the schema-runtime infrastructure failure, preserve the 157/142 library, and authorize Campaign159 only from a genuinely new raw state or an exact pre-row source contract.
